content.text:
This file already looks quite polished (accessible slider control, prefers-reduced-motion handling, localStorage sync across tabs, restart-on-speed-change, etc.). Before I make changes, what direction do you want improvement in?

- **Visual/design**: different colors, size, add more visual variety
- **Accessibility**: further ARIA/keyboard refinements
- **Features**: e.g., more speed options, color picker, export/share settings
- **Code quality**: refactor for cleaner structure, split into separate CSS/JS files
- **Bug fixes**: I can point out a couple of minor rough edges I noticed (e.g., the `circleBtn` click only cycles speed forward, no drag support for the "slider" role; rapid arrow-key presses trigger unnecessary reflows)

Let me know which area matters most, or if you just want me to pick the highest-impact fixes.
